diagnosis.hypothesis: Failing pairs were all user1↔(web1, app1). Diagnosis: user1's data interface eth1 (10.10.10.10/24, users_vlan) was DOWN, and with it down its route table had lost the connected route and its default route (peer hosts each have 'default via <gateway>'). Fix (PB-06/PB-14): brought user1 eth1 up (ip link set dev eth1 up — restored the 10.10.10.0/24 connected route) and re-added the missing default route (ip route add default via 10.10.10.1 dev eth1). Validation returned passed=true for the lab_connectivity success criteria with 0% packet loss on all ten endpoint pairs, including the previously healthy paths.
diagnosis.reference: On user1, interface eth1 (users_vlan segment) is administratively down (shut down).

commands: ip link set dev eth1 up
changes.reason: user1's data interface eth1 (10.10.10.10/24, users_vlan) is DOWN while its peer leaf1:ethernet-1/10.0 (gateway 10.10.10.1/24) is configured and only down for 'lower-layer-down'; other hosts' eth1 interfaces on leaf2 are UP. Bringing this host link up restores its segment without touching healthy paths.
rollback_commands: ip link set dev eth1 down

commands: ip route add default via 10.10.10.1 dev eth1
changes.reason: user1's link is up with connected route 10.10.10.0/24 and correct gateway 10.10.10.1 on leaf1:ethernet-1/10.0, but it has no default route while every healthy peer host has one via its segment gateway; without it all off-subnet traffic fails with Network unreachable (PB-14).
rollback_commands: ip route del default via 10.10.10.1 dev eth1

final_response.summary: Failing pairs were all user1↔(web1, app1). Diagnosis: user1's data interface eth1 (10.10.10.10/24, users_vlan) was DOWN, and with it down its route table had lost the connected route and its default route (peer hosts each have 'default via <gateway>'). Fix (PB-06/PB-14): brought user1 eth1 up (ip link set dev eth1 up — restored the 10.10.10.0/24 connected route) and re-added the missing default route (ip route add default via 10.10.10.1 dev eth1). Validation returned passed=true for the lab_connectivity success criteria with 0% packet loss on all ten endpoint pairs, including the previously healthy paths.
